cases.title: Parcel 854: Spruce Court
cases.claim: Parcel 854 was delivered to its recipient by 17:00 on 2 November.

initial_records.text: The application shows Parcel 854 as DELIVERED at 17:18 at Spruce Court.
The courier's device was offline at 17:18. The log does not establish whether the entry time or upload time reflects the scan time.

cases.initial_rationale: The ambiguous timestamp and route status do not establish a handoff by the deadline or a verified return.

updates.notice: The device clock was compared with the depot clock.

record.text: The 17:18 time was the upload time. The scan occurred at 16:42, but the route application still records only a location scan, not a recipient handoff.

updates.rationale: The audit moves the scan before the deadline but does not turn a location scan into evidence of handoff.

updates.notice: The recipient's building supplied a time-stamped receipt.

record.text: The signed register confirms Parcel 854 was handed to the named recipient at 16:48 on 2 November.

updates.rationale: The verified handoff occurred before the deadline and establishes delivery.
